lastGatePass: Local release regression is green: format, lint, typecheck, 37 React tests, 98 baseline tests, client changes 32/32, video parity 210/210, traceability mirror, audit 17/17, build, Selenium 176/176 (shared local server) and Playwright 178/178.
failingGate: External release certification is pending: no configured Vercel deployment URL is available for a new READY deployment and production smoke.
repairsApplied: Prettier LF enforcement and complete global Playwright repair (178/178 PASS).
Inventory movement creation and missing closure-approval boundary Selenium evidence (25/25 inventory tests; 39/39 inventory coverage with execution evidence).

Selenium credential clearing, agenda date/time native setters, clinical/hospitalization fixtures and filter events, medical-orders support isolation, and patient canonical login/save/address contracts.
Patient address boundary test passes using PATIENT-ADDRESS-IMPORT without external map integration.
Patient document-type test passes after aligning the Document label; contact-document lookup now uses the canonical row-level Detalle link and needs retest.

Patient Selenium module reconciled with v3 segmented mock storage, current dialog/action identifiers, searchable insurer, table columns, and row-level detail navigation (16/16 PASS; 36/36 execution coverage PASS).
Global Selenium smoke now authenticates ADMIN and validates current protected flows, safe Help fallback, resource registration prerequisites, and scheduled-hours reporting (6/6 PASS).

Added authentic Selenium coverage for AUTH-LOGIN and AUTH-LOGOUT: test_ch01 records each action at runtime, the inventory declares SEL-CH01-LOGIN/SEL-CH01-LOGOUT, and CH01 passes 5/5. Global declared coverage rose from 301/339 (88.79%) to 303/339 (89.38%).

Repaired quote Selenium fixtures for segmented v3 storage, mandatory referral selection, React-controlled native dates, stable selected-referral assertions, shared inventory-only state, and the explicit update-line control. Quotes passed 21/21; global Selenium passed 176/176 and Playwright passed 178/178.
nextExecutableAction: Commit and push the repaired release branch, then link/configure the authorized Vercel project, obtain a new READY deployment, and run the required production smoke for the six demo roles and patient portal. Preserve the explicit client/integration blockers; do not mark globalComplete true before external certification.
